items.title: What Is T Mobile US (TMUS) Proving With Its 5G Race Weekend Role?
items.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) supplied advanced 5G services to support operations at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix in 2026. The carrier deployed tools such as network slicing and private 5G networks to manage venue connectivity during the Las Vegas event. Real-time 3D operations control and dedicated links for staff and first responders were used to monitor race activities and safety systems.
